notes.title: Release Schedule Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, Lina here! Today we've got a very big and important announcement to share regarding the future of Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter.

We're not allowed to name names at the moment, but [b]Kumitantei has received strong interest and an offer from a game publisher[/b] which we're excited to move ahead with! This will mean our team getting the support we need to make the game bigger and better, and will guarantee Kumitantei's completion! 

We're very pumped to share more info about this in the near future, but in the meantime, this does mean [b]we'll be needing to delay Episode 1 until Early 2026[/b] to ensure it's polished up to the standards of our new partners. The wait will have to be a little longer, but it'll be worth it. 

We hope you'll understand, and thank you very much for all of your support! We'll see you in the next update! notes.title: Development Update #5: Steam Next Fest and Voice Cast Trailer Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Lina here with a new update! 🎴👾

First off, thank you all so much for your very prompt responses to our Backer Survey last month! We’ve got nearly everyone’s preferences now and are so excited to start working with all of the folks who chose creative rewards! We’re also pleased to say that the full in-game credits with all of our backers will be included in the coming Demo Update, which we’ll get into in a moment, but first…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/0a3d94e69bf53a2ccd769ffcbb27374100d0024e.png[/img]

Our current estimate for Episode 1’s development progress is [b]62%[/b], which has been a bit slower with some of us being students with finals, but our great pace before has kept us on track! Here’s the breakdown:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/fa0ef3776e80a9bfa1884892e3612e2a7396dc67.png[/img]

As we enter the summer months, we’ll be picking up a lot of speed with the finish line in sight, we don’t foresee any delays with hitting our target release window in [b]Q3 2025[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/b1765afa09f10fe9c4d802879d3564e133b29445.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/01ddec1a07bc100ecf87ed2da684bf409d87d54f.png[/img]

We’re excited to formally announce that Kumitantei will be a part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest_comingsoon?l=english][b]Steam Next Fest’s June 2025 edition, running from June 9th - 16th[/b][/url]! Next Fest is an incredible triannual showcase of upcoming games from thousands of talented developers, featuring tons of free demos to try out and wishlist! If you haven’t already been checking them out every few months, you definitely should be!

If you also haven’t already, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2759280/Kumitantei_OldSchool_Slaughter/]wishlist Kumitantei on Steam[/url]! It helps us way more than you’d probably think!

To coincide with our participation, on June 9th we’ll be releasing our[b] biggest update to the Demo Version yet[/b], as well as a brand new [b]Voice Cast Trailer[/b] via premiere on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@MangoFactoryEN]our YouTube channel[/url]! We hope to see you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/9d5578940140ac780e23c52a437544586808008b.png[/img]

As we’ve been alluding to, we’ve got a [b]big update coming to the Demo on June 9th[/b]! This one’s gonna be bringing more QoL improvements, new pretty Episode Start and End graphics, the complete in-game credits, and most importantly… voice acting! The whole cast have been lovingly brought to life by an incredibly talented group of voice actors, and we’re so excited to reveal who’s playing who and give you all the opportunity to hear their performances in action next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/0d6959f27ff1b29ea046f3ce8c0dd18817145f55.gif[/img]

As you can see, the Prologue is now properly titled “The World They Knew”. While it’s always had this name internally, we just didn’t have an opportunity to share it until now! Yay, something new to theorize about! 

Since we’ve been building up a lot to share during Next Fest and through the Voice Cast Trailer, this Backer Update is slightly shorter than our usual ones. It’s very important to us to keep you all informed, but we hope you all can understand waiting an extra week for the big stuff. However…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/c578f21a8fd33909677d2e1eaeb267baf6c598a5.png[/img]

That’s not to say we’re quite done today! For all of your support and patience, we’re giving you guys the first real look at a location you’ll soon become very familiar with! Welcome to the bunker’s eerie and imposing Trial Room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/6c97e5b280bf9d51adab44932dede0cae9d497d7.png[/img]

This will be the setting of the Clinical Trials, where the class will be forced to debate the truth and eventually condemn one another to death. It certainly fits the part, wouldn’t you agree? You’ll get to see a more thorough look next week in the Voice Cast Trailer, but this first peek is just for you guys! 🎴🖤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/ac7ca8da8dc334a8a9065d470a9514a9ff216d27.png[/img]

That’s about all we’ve got to share for this little amuse bouche of an update, we really hope you’ll all join us for the main course next week! Thank you to each and every one of our backers for your support and patience, it’s genuinely such an honour having this amount of faith in our team. We’ll try our best to keep living up to (and hopefully exceeding) your expectations!

notes.title: Development Update #4: Scriptwriting Completed, Voice Acting Confirmed and More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Lina here with a new update! 🎴🐰

Don’t worry, we know it’s been a bit since the last one, and we’re sorry for the wait between them. To be blunt, we didn’t really like how the last few had been so light on stuff to actually share, and so instead we elected to hold off until we had enough ready to be worthy of your time. We don’t intend on having another gap like this for the foreseeable future.

As alluded to though, we have a whole lot to show off for this update, so let’s get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/0a3d94e69bf53a2ccd769ffcbb27374100d0024e.png[/img]

As of now, our estimate for Episode 1’s current progress is 50%, which with a whole lot of hard work is actually slightly ahead of our intended pace! Here’s the breakdown:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/636d4283121738fcaf1c57e7fac0de87c513a4f4.png[/img]

As mentioned in the previous update, we’ll still be sending out our Backer Survey in May to collect our supporters’ reward preferences (such as choosing platforms for your game keys) in preparation for the Early Access release, so keep an eye on your inboxes then!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/6a28cb66498aa3caa02e4bae64eec9cb7e32cfc0.png[/img]

The biggest leap in progress since our last update is in the writing department, where we can confirm that Episode 1’s whole script is now complete! That means every line of dialogue is finalized, clocking in at a total 56,200 words with an estimated ~5 hours of playtime!

That’s a whole lot of text to read for just one Episode, right? Luckily that leads us into our next topic…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/add5e7f40a13f7547d49753b6a86d21d48ba4195.png[/img]

That’s right! We can officially confirm full English voice acting for Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter! It took a lot of budgeting and logistics wizardry, but we managed to find the money to cast and pay an incredibly talented group of voice actors, courtesy of our amazing casting director [url=https://x.com/MiaPaigeVA][b]Mia Paige[/b][/url]!

We’ll be announcing our cast and their roles at a later date, but for now it’s just so exciting to be doing this at all! This was one of the big stretch goals we sadly ended up not able to hit, so to be able to follow through on it anyways is a big deal for us (and hopefully you guys are excited too)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/c578f21a8fd33909677d2e1eaeb267baf6c598a5.png[/img]

Next up, we’d like to share a preview of the next area you’ll be able to explore in Episode 1, the Living Quarters! Here you’ll find the cast’s dormitories, the cafeteria, the locker room, and the laundry room! Every comfort necessary for a long, eventful stay in the Bunker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/12a92e844e29914ffeb4eea9b20086b5a6aeb31c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/d6ee490c4e429106107596d2d08979fcc5966cee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/fefbe037a9fc417b4d1c3bc0cc838da4217e1146.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/4173c1f9bb8a0ea94469b8135faaf60640b94158.png[/img]

The extra fortifications should protect this level from any collapse caused by seismic activity. Maybe. Hopefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/03a2223a84c4f0c76cff26bc5dbe4bae73819262.png[/img]

On a less ominous note, we’re excited to show off the second of our Retro Minigames, a classic-style space shooter called [b]Cosmidors[/b]! Alongside Merlite, this new game will be playable as a proper arcade game in the Prize Corner, while also having unique remix challenges within the Clinical Trial!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/9b6f5eafddd7f376ef531f4345c8cc533d5c8f98.png[/img]

While of course very reminiscent of games from the period, Cosmidors has a pretty unique twist with its time-warping gameplay! You’ll need to manage your warp charge alongside your missiles to be able to defeat the attacking alien fleet, and bend time itself to strike enemies that are otherwise invulnerable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/741d3b48127cb35493794e87b4b0f7f99ac94507.gif[/img]

Going for high scores in the Prize Corner makes for a very fun time-sink, so we hope you’ll enjoy this new addition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/4165b13b01f2e1a8675e937e33cff8835d713739.png[/img]

Next, we just wanna showcase a few of the new character sprites our art team has been cooking for Episode 1, particularly for Tsubaki, Hiroshi, and Kazan! They’re so expressive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/645cfa8f9e1080c041b8b561f52e7128fc947cd6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/fbb37a933b6a98234d52c132e86712cb040d6079.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/7ed26729b0abde688e1f7e8d073630f9983fd811.png[/img]

Before anyone asks, none of these sprites we’re sharing ahead of time contain spoiler content, so don’t think too hard about them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/ac7ca8da8dc334a8a9065d470a9514a9ff216d27.png[/img]

That about wraps up everything we’ve got to talk about for now, but that doesn’t mean we’re vanishing again! Next month we’ll be sharing another beefy update, revealing the voice cast and discussing our participation in the June 2025 edition of Steam Next Fest alongside a new Demo Update! 

Thank you all so much for your patience and taking the time to read this, we really hope it reassures everyone that we’re not dead and still hitting our goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/57228c16744e5932ad780f52b24c470ede12a8f5.png[/img]

notes.title: February 17th Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter Demo! This update adds the Scanner to the Story Demo alongside a limited version of the Pause Menu you will find in the full release, as well as a new opponent and some balance changes for the Battle Demo.

[h3][b]Story Demo[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the Scanner, accessible with right-click or Y/Triangle by default on controller. The Scanner reveals all interactable objects when triggered.
[*] The Pause Menu has a new visual overhaul, as well as the new Bonds menu that updates and fills out as you progress through the demo and talk to each character.
[list]
[*] The "Save and Quit to Title" option has been moved to the System menu.
[/list]
[*] Added the new song "Nyanus, Your Overseer" to the gym cutscene.
[*] After idling for 7.5 seconds, an input guide for basic actions will appear. It will disappear after moving or pressing a button.
[/list]
[h3][b]Battle Demo[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Art for Skill Cards has been updated with new art.
[*] The Combo Timer and Influence gauge are now paused for the entire duration of the immediate effects of Skill Cards.
[*] Skill Cards are now shuffled into the top half of the deck to make them more accessible and allow for strategies to become more consistent.
[*] Tsubaki is now available as an opponent.
[*] Added the [b]Palaeontologist[/b] Skill Card, which fully reshuffles your deck and draws new cards. Levels 3+ reduce the speed of the Combo Timer.
[*] The [b]Plastic Surgeon[/b] Skill Card has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Levels 1-2 change 2 random Debate Cards into the winning type.
[*] Levels 3+ change 3 random Debate Cards into the winning type.
[*] Changed the winning card value boost for every level. Now is 1 card, 2 cards, 2 cards, 3 cards, and all cards respectively for each level. [/list][/list]
[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] The game now renders 3D environments at 75% of the set resolution, which boosts performance.
[*] Added outlines around most visual elements.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which various shader effects would freeze and change over very long periods of time.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update #3: Episode 1's Progress and Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Lina here with another update! 🎴🎆

This one’s gonna be a little different from the previous few, we thought it’d be good to take a more macro view of the project’s progress this time and cover some questions we’ve been getting!

First though, we want to talk a little bit about the Demo Update coming next month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/9d5578940140ac780e23c52a437544586808008b.png[/img]

As mentioned before, a substantial update to the Kumitantei Demo Version is coming very soon, and we’re excited to announce it’s coming [b]February 17th[/b]! In it you’ll find the addition of Tsubaki as a Battle Demo opponent (as seen last month), as well as graphical and performance updates and the highly requested introduction of the Scanner in exploration! 

We’ll be showing previews of the new Demo content on our Bluesky and YouTube Community pages over the coming weeks, so be sure to follow those!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/0a3d94e69bf53a2ccd769ffcbb27374100d0024e.png[/img]

Right now we estimate that Episode 1’s production is about [b]30% complete[/b], which is right on pace for us to release it in [b]Q3 2025[/b] as planned! Let’s check out the specifics of our progress:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/797522dab8fd2e29bb497e8d25432fdac8e76177.png[/img]
Our focus currently is completing and polishing Episode 1’s script after finalizing the scenario for it last month. For everyone wondering, doing the Demo Update for February has been to keep us making consistent progress across departments for general things not specific to the plot while we wait for the completed script, it hasn’t been a distraction from working on Episode 1 at all. 

As for Episode 1’s release plan, as stated above our planned window is still Q3 of 2025, and with Episode 1 [b]the game will be released into Early Access on Steam[/b]. We’re using the Early Access model for our Episodic release phase to ensure clarity of the game not yet being complete, and to encourage players to share their feedback with us while we gradually update and add in the narrative’s six Episodes. During this time, [b]we intend on having the game’s price initially discounted on Steam and increasing with each Episode addition, then exiting Early Access when the game is complete[/b].

You may have noticed from our previous few Backer Updates that we’ve been silent regarding the promised Nintendo Switch port of Kumitantei, and as you might have guessed, we were ourselves waiting for more information about the Nintendo Switch’s successor. With the news now of Nintendo Switch 2’s full backwards compatibility with its predecessor, we’re very excited to be supporting both generations of the system. [b]We intend on releasing the full game on Nintendo Switch (and by extension Nintendo Switch 2) once we’ve left Early Access and officially launch, still intended for Late 2027[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/02ad2ecc320ad8d33e853f886b25ff6ba92cd750.png[/img]

Now that was a whole lot of densely packed information, so we’re gonna end this month’s update with something more mellow... the very first preview OST track of Episode 1 titled “Liminal Morning” and courtesy of Hundotte. It’s a relaxing coffee shop bossa nova-inspired alternative version of Liminal Apathy, which will of course be heard during each in-game morning! Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=0GfTteHYRZ4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/ac7ca8da8dc334a8a9065d470a9514a9ff216d27.png[/img]

We know this Backer Update was way more of an info dump than a showcase like our previous ones were, but we thought it was important to give you guys a better look behind the curtain and clear up all the concerns regarding releases and rewards. Plus with the holidays and focusing on writing right now there’s not really a ton of flashy spoiler-free stuff to share, so it just kinda worked out to do this now.

You guys have given us so much support, and so we want to be as transparent as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/57228c16744e5932ad780f52b24c470ede12a8f5.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update #2: Events, Demo Update and Music
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Lina here! 🎴🎄

First things first, we'd love to wish you all a Merry Christmas from the whole Mango Factory team! 

It's been a roller-coaster of a year for us and we're so honoured having you all along for the ride! That said, we've got plenty of gifts to share with you all, starting with this stunning holiday artwork from our Art Director AlyenGhoul!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/3866bbb44676db6781876d583712c37c7810b4e9.png[/img]

With our Absolute Plastic Surgeon's birthday likewise being December 25th, spotlighting her here was an easy choice. Check out all the little details!

Now onto the (slightly) more meaty stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/44cb5bf531da8d8caaa3703a82a1e2b4b6f89b7e.png[/img]

We're very excited to talk about a few digital events we're taking part in over the coming months, starting with Southeast Asia Games Onward 2024!

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/25278687-Virtual-SEA-Games-from-SEAsia/sale/seago


[previewyoutube=naJt7DUJ10I;full][/previewyoutube]

As an Indonesia-based studio, we were so honoured to be invited to one of the largest showcases of our region’s upcoming games, and we hope you'll all come check it out! There's additionally a video presentation being hosted on December 29th over on the organizer’s YouTube channel.

Then in February, we'll also be a part of Two and a Half Studios’ event called The Storyteller’s Festival, a big celebration of narrative games and visual novels! More info on that next month, but we'll have something very special for the occasion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/9d5578940140ac780e23c52a437544586808008b.png[/img]

In February 2025, we'll be releasing a content update for the Kumitantei Demo Version to polish it up in line with our standards for Episode 1, including bugfixes, QoL improvements, new features, and what we're revealing today... Tsubaki Inōe as a brand new Battle Demo opponent!

notes.title: Development Update #1: UI and Social Media
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Lina here!

It's been a whole month already since Episode 1 was successfully funded and our last update, but don't worry, we're not dead yet! We spent the last two weeks of October giving the team a well deserved break, and on November 4th we all got right back to work.

Let's see what's new, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/a25ef05db64d983f67f956e702ce6e4e3d9e2cde.png[/img]

Graphic design is, genuinely, one of the most difficult parts of creating a game. It takes such a unique blend of artistic and technical skills to create good menus for video games, especially considering how when designed well they go largely unnoticed.

…I say all of that just to preface how GyleToTheRescue, our Motion Graphic Designer, makes it look easy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/88cee89def84d319eb5a4011f198ab80f2afea9d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/775348026b437ee959211c5baf73eae7e6842f8e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/e505255622903ae0d1f29aa275493bc267e434ad.gif[/img]

These beautifully smooth and stylized Pause Menus hearken back to manga and advertising of the 1980s, making all of the settings and info you'll need easily accessible and visually striking! 

We hope you'll all enjoy this eye-candy as we continue pushing forward. Given how much of our current workload is backend or spoilery, we're a little dry on things we can showcase for this month, but hope to have more in a few weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/adac191e5891fb6e6d9590b78342e1cbb9da35ba.png[/img]

Quite a bit has happened outside the confines of game development in the last few weeks, as I'm sure many of you are aware. 

Just to cut to the chase, we're phasing out our activities on Ex-Twitter and have already begun shifting our social media presence to Bluesky.

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/mangofactory.win][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/d266231572798505e965fc09fd50e59c9206eb54.png[/img][/url]

You can follow us there using the button above, and, we've even prepared a [url=https://go.bsky.app/5jL8nGk][b]Starter Pack with our dev team + collaborators![/b][/url]

In addition, something we've been asked a lot is how to support us further now with the Kickstarter concluded. Our answer to that is Ko-fi!

[url=https://ko-fi.com/mangofactory][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/71dbe8e24910ae1f68d56470a196fda6bd05bc77.png[/img][/url]

For those uninitiated, Ko-fi is a platform very similar to Patreon except way less predatory. It allows us to both take one-time donations and offer recurring monthly Memberships, meaning that if someone wants to help us out, they can in whatever capacity they prefer.

Donations and Memberships on our Ko-fi support our team directly instead of going into Kumitantei’s development, so Kickstarter Backer rewards will not be offered through the platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818878/ac7ca8da8dc334a8a9065d470a9514a9ff216d27.png[/img]

I know we've said this a lot, but we mean it so sincerely: Thank you, everyone, for every ounce of faith and support you've given us. We're so honoured to have such a dedicated and tight-knit community.

As I said, this update is a little light due to the circumstances, but now we're locked in and making sure the next one’s more bountiful. See you then!

[h2]Our Goal is to Reach [b]$20,000[/b] to Fund the First Episode[/h2]

Bringing the world of Kumitantei to life is going to be no easy task, but with your support we're certain that we can take this to the finish line! This $20,000 will allow us to complete the game's first episode and core features for Switch and PC, and ensure we're able to fulfill all of the rewards for our backers!

With every $10,000 after that allowing us to finish the planned six episodes of Kumitantei in full!

Here's how exactly we intend to use it:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EDk3qZ6.png[/img]

Then, if we're lucky enough to pass our base funding goal, we've got a variety of extra features we'd love to include as Stretch Goals! Take a look at them here, and note we'll be adding new ones as they're achieved!

[h2]Rewards[/h2]

[h2]Why Kickstarter?[/h2]

Kickstarter's reputation as a platform for creative people to share and support each other precedes it, and it's been the catalyst for hundreds of games that otherwise would likely have never been made. Like those before us, Kumitantei is a labour of love and the realization of many years in planning, so we want to ensure that our vision can be realised unimpeded.

Basically, getting involved with a publisher or more structured investors so early on in the life of such a niche type of game could be detrimental to achieving what we want to do with this, and so crowdfunding seems like the best way to make the game we want to make (and hopefully the one you want to play)! 

We've been working on Kumitantei part-time since October 2022, but we want to be able to fully dedicate ourselves to it going forward and that requires a bit of financial support. We're committed to putting everything we have into this game, every single day, until we can deliver you a game that's equal parts beautiful, haunting, thought-provoking, and fun. The money, support, feedback, and everything in-between that you provide us will be worth it.

notes.title: September 14th Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter Demo! This update adds some quality of life features as well as adjusting defense in the Battle Demo.

[b]Story Demo[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the Message Log. This displays all previous messages in the current scene in order and can be scrolled using up and down.
[*]Added the ability to toggle the UI during dialogue scenes. This cannot be done during animated scenes.
[/list]
[b]Battle Demo[/b]
[list]
[*]The How to Play section has gotten multiple adjustments, notably in the inclusion of visuals to help convey information.
[*]Defense has been reworked during a Combo.
[list]
[*]During a Combo, the length of it significantly reduces the value of the defending card instead of completely ignoring the value.
[*]Debate Cards with a value of 4 or lower still ignore the value of the defending card during a Combo.
[*]The current defense of a card is displayed on top of its value, if it is modified.
[/list]
[*]The [b]Knight[/b] Skill Card now applies a Defense boost instead of limiting incoming damage.
[*]With the Defense system changes, a 1 will act as a 10 against defending cards with any value greater than or equal to 8.
[*]The decks and difficulty of each fight has been fine-tuned and adjusted to help ease players into the game system.
[/list]

notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=AS-d5eks_E8;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2759280/Kumitantei_OldSchool_Slaughter/

[h2]Is Survival in the Cards?[/h2]

[b]Kumitantei: Old School Slaughter[/b] is an ode to retro anime and pop culture stylings of 1980s Japan. Combining the artistic inspirations of Rumiko Takahashi with Danganronpa’s narrative design, the game blends hand-drawn details and a twisted horror narrative. Begin the journey alongside sixteen high school students trapped in an apocalyptic bunker. As a class, you’re goaded toward grisly murder by a sadistic overseer, forced to participate in a deadly psychological experiment that may cost your life. Playing as the sheepish barista Himari Sanada, it’s your job to investigate these murders, earn the trust of your fellow students, and uncover the truth of your macabre capture.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WQruUzF.gif[/img]

[h2]Card Battle Combat[/h2]

Progress through Kumitantei’s gruesome story by forging bonds, battling other students, and unraveling twisted mysteries. In this kill-or-be-killed scenario, the game’s trust system can offer unique leverage opportunities in combat. Spending time with fellow classmates and offering them appropriate gifts unlocks new talent cards and advantages in future card battles. These 1-on-1 battles are a hectic tug-of-war for influence; deal attacks with Debate cards, finding weaknesses in your opponent’s argument to grow your influence. As the battle progresses, present proper evidence against your opponent and strike with The Final Word to silence them. Additional talent cards are available to strengthen your gameplay, and high trust levels with other students may present advantages in battle.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0QFl4x4.gif[/img]

[h2]Kickstarter Launching This Fall[/h2]

[b]Kumitantei's Kickstarter campaign will launch on September 24th and conclude on October 22nd[/b], and a demo of the game will be also available for download during this time.

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mangofactory/kumitantei-old-school-slaughter?ref=clipboard-prelaunch]Follow us on Kickstarter to be notified as soon as it goes live.[/url][/b]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mangofactory/kumitantei-old-school-slaughter?ref=clipboard-prelaunch][img]https://i.imgur.com/LuSE4bl.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Gameplay Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Solve complex cases to discover the truth in an engaging murder mystery narrative.
[*] Encounter sixteen uniquely gifted students locked in a deadly psychological experiment.
[*] Bond with fellow participants to earn their trust, investigate gruesome crime scenes, and use your findings to uncover the truth.
[*] Unlock special rewards as you increase your trust levels with classmates.
[*] Purchase additional talent cards with in-game currency to strengthen your deck.
[*] Leverage your relationships in card battles and gain advantages against your opponent.
[*] Experience fast-paced Card Debates and retro minigames, all in the game’s signature 1980s anime style.
[/list]
